diagram_candidates.content: Draw the unit disc D in the xy-plane, mark the vertical section at a representative x in [-1,1], and label its endpoints y=±sqrt(1-x^2) and length 2sqrt(1-x^2).
checks: The drawn sections are empty for |x|>1 and have the stated endpoints for |x|≤1.
The section-length label agrees with the integrand in the Cavalieri formula.
This is explanatory; the written proof already establishes the area identity.

diagram_candidates.content: Draw [0,1) split into the three level-one branches I_{1,a}; show D_3(x)=3x-a on each branch, shade the preimage intervals [0,1/9), [1/3,4/9), [2/3,7/9) of [0,1/3), and show each level-two interval I_{2,3a+c} mapping onto I_{1,c}.
checks: The three shaded preimage intervals are disjoint half-open intervals with total length 1/3.
Each affine branch maps I_{2,3a+c} bijectively to I_{1,c}, including the excluded endpoint at 1.
Labels preserve the digit convention: branch a is the first ternary digit and the image deletes that digit.

scope: Local frozen ItemBody previews only. No production route, live site, HTTP(S), external images, item edits, publication changes, builds, tests, or gates were accessed.
